name: Fugu Ultra
title: Fugu Ultra: price, context window and specs
answer: Fugu Ultra is a model in Sakana's Sakana Fugu family, first listed on 2026-06-24. It takes text and image in and returns text, with a context window of 1 million tokens and up to 128K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $5 per million input tokens and $30 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are not published, so it is reached through an API.
compare: It is the oldest of the 3 versions of Sakana Fugu still listed.
Its input price is the family median, $5 per million tokens.
No version in the family has a larger context window.
